reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model PA-10, which is a recalled model.
The label's date code 2126 falls within the recalled range of 2126 to 2319.
The purchase was made at Amazon.com, a listed retailer, on 2021-08-27, which is inside the sale window of 2021-06-01 to 2023-11-30. No receipt is required for this retailer.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this claim.
The remedy requested is repair or replacement with no refund, so the value threshold does not apply and no destruction photo is required.
